# PayTo Wallets

PayTo Wallets scans PayTo payment URIs from NFC NDEF tags, saves them on the Flipper Zero, and emulates a selected wallet as an NFC tag.

Wallets can also be entered manually. Saved wallets support custom names, showing the full URI, NFC streaming, and removal.

The app is intended for testing and sharing PayTo payment addresses. It does not hold private keys or sign transactions.
